notes: This focused trace covers IEEE 1516.1-2025 §11.3.1 p. 290 l. 33-10 through the observed handling of each tested MOM leaf class, §11.4.1 p. 290 l. 156 (active RTI subscription to Table 7 S leaves), and bounded no-tag/no-timestamp behavior across selected callbacks. The portable C++ TCK and Catch2 tests provide direct evidence only for their exercised leaves and callback paths; the contract twin reuses the same TCK scenario and is not independent evidence. No complete MOM service semantics, provider validation, interoperability, or conformance is claimed.

requirements.source: IEEE 1516.1-2025 §11.4.1, Table 7; pinned Requirements Lab candidate
requirements.source_symbol: HLAmanager leaf interaction classes designated Subscribe (S)
requirements.statement: The RTI shall be actively subscribed to all leaf interaction classes in Table 7 that are designated with an S.

requirements.source_symbol: RTI-originated report interactions exercised by Table 7 S-leaf requests
requirements.statement: The RTI shall never provide timestamps or user-supplied tags with instance attribute updates, sent interactions, or object instance deletion.
tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_joined_federate_mom_public_object_lifecycle_catch2.cpp::Embedded joined-federate MOM objects use the public discovery reflection and removal route

requirements.source_symbol: Instance attribute updates, sent interactions, and object instance deletion
requirements.statement: Across the paired Table 7 S-leaf and joined-federate MOM lifecycle scenarios, the RTI provides no timestamps or user-supplied tags on the exercised report interactions, Table 8 initial/request attribute updates, or resignation-triggered object deletions. This is bounded evidence for the three callback categories, not a universal audit of every RTI output path.

requirements.source_symbol: RTI subscription to the specific MOM leaf interaction class
requirements.statement: The RTI shall subscribe at the MOM leaf-class level (e.g., HLAmanager.HLAfederate.HLAadjust.HLAsetTiming).
